compiled_text: The completed yacht with a complete hull shell, an open main deck, the superstructure, fitted glazing, twin hull door openings at midships, an observation blister below the bow waterline, a flush helideck on the foredeck, a mast, a full-width stern water platform and stepped terraces; no scaffolding. Surfaces: hull shell in final paint, main deck in teak, superstructure in final paint, glazing in final tinted glass.
